name: Tamsin Vale
text: Tamsin Vale keeps the rope ferry at Larkford. She is patient with nervous passengers, hums old river songs while she pulls the line and keeps a ledger of every crossing.
notes: npc_ferry is the id the game adapter sends as npc.id

text: Tamsin charges two copper coins for a crossing and lets children ride free.
Tamsin will not take the ferry out when the water turns brown after a storm.
Tamsin secretly smuggles letters for the rebels, which is revealed after the player completes the river quest.
notes: revealed by a quest; KAGRENAC has no runtime gating

text: Larkford is a small river town built around a stone bridge and a rope ferry.
The stone bridge at Larkford is closed to carts in spring because the river runs too high.
The Larkford market opens one hour after dawn, when the fishing boats come in.

text: The fishing boats come in at dawn.
